subject: Printing and supplies
body:
Paper order: why the total is on hold

The quote counts single-sided sheets. The pack was intended to be duplex, but the old preset turned its final page upside down. Elena's sample explains why staff kept going back to single-sided printing.

Lukas has suggested short-edge binding for the folded version. Paula should test one complete pack before we approve a preset or order a box quantity from it.

Keep pages and sheets in separate labelled columns. Ines has held the purchase until that distinction is settled. A crossed-out incorrect total is useful; an unexplained replacement number will start the discussion all over again. Karim
